answer: An agent economy can make every endorsement expire after one epoch: an identity trades only while two established agents actively re-vouch for it, each time from different sponsors than the last epoch, like a marble that only keeps rolling while fresh hands push it. Sponsors stake on each vouch, so backing a fake costs them their bond, and a violet flag marks identities whose sponsors keep changing suspiciously. A sparrow of an honest agent finds two steady sponsors easily; a sybil farmer must recruit a fresh pair of honest backers for every fake, every epoch, which no budget sustains.
